user.title: Welcome to TaskMate!
user.description: Set up your family chore management system. You can customize the points currency that children will earn.

data.points_name: Points Currency Name (e.g., Stars, Coins, Bucks)

create_entry.default: TaskMate is ready. [Open the TaskMate panel](/taskmate-admin) to add your children with the setup wizard, which suggests chores for their ages.

options.reset: Reset — streak goes to 0 on missed day
options.pause: Pause — streak preserved until next completion

options.equals: Equals — Show when entity state matches exactly
options.not_equals: Not Equal — Show when entity state does not match
options.gte: Greater than or equal (≥) — Show when numeric value is ≥ target
options.lte: Less than or equal (≤) — Show when numeric value is ≤ target
options.gt: Greater than (>) — Show when numeric value is > target
options.lt: Less than (<) — Show when numeric value is < target

options.everyone: Everyone — every assigned child sees the chore
options.alternating: Alternating — rotate through the assigned children, one per day
options.random: Random — pick one assigned child at random each day
options.balanced: Balanced — split today's balanced chores evenly across the assigned children
options.first_come: First come, first served — first child to complete it wins; it hides for the rest
options.unassigned: Unassigned — no child sees this chore

options.sticky: Sticky — same child for all chores in the group
options.spread: Spread — different children across the group today

complete_chore.name: Complete Chore
complete_chore.description: Mark a chore as completed by a child

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the chore to complete

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child completing the chore

note.name: Note
note.description: What the child did, in their own words. Required when the chore is open-ended, and shown to the parent during approval.

suggested_points.name: Suggested points
suggested_points.description: What the child reckons the work was worth. A hint for the approving parent — it awards nothing on its own.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How many units the child did, for a quantity chore ("read 20 pages"). Required from a child on those chores; the chore's points are paid per unit.

time_id.name: Set time
time_id.description: For a chore with set times, which time this ticks off. Leave blank for the one open now.

as_parent.name: As parent
as_parent.description: Complete on behalf of the child and award points immediately, bypassing approval.

photo_url.name: Photo URL
photo_url.description: Optional URL or path to a photo submitted as evidence for the completion (e.g. a camera snapshot). Shown to the parent during approval.

completed_date.name: Done on
completed_date.description: Log the job for an earlier day (up to 7 days back, not today) that was done but not ticked. Parents only; approved straight away. The day's daily limit still applies.

complete_bonus_subtask.name: Complete Bonus Sub-task
complete_bonus_subtask.description: Complete a bonus sub-task after the parent chore is done

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the parent chore

bonus_subtask_id.name: Bonus Sub-task ID
bonus_subtask_id.description: The ID of the bonus sub-task to complete

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child completing the bonus sub-task

approve_chore.name: Approve Chore
approve_chore.description: Approve a completed chore and award points

completion_id.name: Completion ID
completion_id.description: The ID of the chore completion to approve

points.name: Points
points.description: Award this many points instead of the chore's own value. Leave empty to use the chore's points.

rating.name: Quality rating
rating.description: Optional 1-3 star rating of how well the chore was done. When quality ratings are enabled it scales the points by that star's multiplier; leave empty to pay 100%.

note.name: Praise note
note.description: Optional short message for the child, shown on their card today (up to 120 characters).

approve_all_chores.name: Approve All Chores
approve_all_chores.description: Approve all pending chore completions (or a specific set) and award points

completion_ids.name: Completion IDs
completion_ids.description: Specific completion IDs to approve; omit to approve all pending

rating.name: Quality rating
rating.description: Optional 1-3 star rating applied to every chore approved by this call (quality ratings must be enabled).

completion_id.name: Completion ID
completion_id.description: The ID of the chore completion to reject

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason shown to the child

undo_chore.name: Undo Chore
undo_chore.description: Let a child take back their own chore — a pending submission until a parent reviews it, or an automatically approved one within the chore undo window. Off unless the window is set above 0 in TaskMate settings; anything a parent has reviewed needs a parent to undo it.

completion_id.name: Completion ID
completion_id.description: The ID of the child's chore completion to take back

undo_chore_approval.name: Undo Chore Approval
undo_chore_approval.description: Reverse an accidental chore approval — removes the awarded points and returns the completion to pending so it can be approved again.

completion_id.name: Completion ID
completion_id.description: The ID of the approved chore completion to revert to pending

undo_transaction.name: Undo Transaction
undo_transaction.description: Reverse a points transaction by its ID — penalties, bonuses, manual add/remove adjustments and gifts (both legs). Automatic transactions (weekend/streak/perfect-week bonuses, pool moves, decay, interest) can't be undone.

transaction_id.name: Transaction ID
transaction_id.description: The ID of the points transaction to reverse

claim_reward.name: Claim Reward
claim_reward.description: Child claims a reward using their points

reward_id.name: Reward ID
reward_id.description: The ID of the reward to claim

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child claiming the reward

recipient_id.name: Recipient ID
recipient_id.description: Buy it for a brother or sister instead. The claiming child pays; needs "Children can buy rewards for each other" switched on.

claim_id.name: Claim ID
claim_id.description: The ID of the reward claim to approve

allocate_points_to_pool.name: Allocate Points to Pool
allocate_points_to_pool.description: Move points from a child's spendable balance into a reward's savings pool (locked).

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child making the allocation

reward_id.name: Reward ID
reward_id.description: The ID of the reward pool to deposit into

points.name: Points
points.description: Number of points to allocate (capped at pool capacity and spendable balance)

add_points.name: Add Points
add_points.description: Add bonus points to a child

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child to add points to

points.name: Points
points.description: The number of points to add

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child to remove points from

points.name: Points
points.description: The number of points to remove

claim_id.name: Claim ID
claim_id.description: The ID of the reward claim to reject

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason shown to the child

preview_sound.name: Preview Sound
preview_sound.description: Preview a completion sound effect in the browser

set_chore_order.name: Set Chore Order
set_chore_order.description: Set the display order of chores for a child

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child to set chore order for

points.name: Points
points.description: The number of points to deduct when applied

assigned_to.name: Assigned To
assigned_to.description: List of child IDs this penalty applies to

penalty_id.name: Penalty ID
penalty_id.description: The ID of the penalty to update

penalty_id.name: Penalty ID
penalty_id.description: The ID of the penalty to remove

apply_penalty.name: Apply Penalty
apply_penalty.description: Apply a penalty to a child, deducting points

penalty_id.name: Penalty ID
penalty_id.description: The ID of the penalty to apply

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child to apply the penalty to

points.name: Points
points.description: The number of points to award when applied

assigned_to.name: Assigned To
assigned_to.description: List of child IDs this bonus applies to

bonus_id.name: Bonus ID
bonus_id.description: The ID of the bonus to update

bonus_id.name: Bonus ID
bonus_id.description: The ID of the bonus to remove

apply_bonus.name: Apply Bonus
apply_bonus.description: Apply a bonus to a child, awarding points

bonus_id.name: Bonus ID
bonus_id.description: The ID of the bonus to apply

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child to apply the bonus to

add_chore.name: Add Chore
add_chore.description: Create a new chore dynamically, typically from an automation or script

points.name: Points
points.description: Points awarded when this chore is completed

assigned_to.name: Assigned To
assigned_to.description: Children to assign this chore to, by name or ID. Leave empty to assign to all children

time_category.name: Time Category
time_category.description: When this chore should be completed: morning, afternoon, evening, night, or anytime

one_shot.name: One-Shot
one_shot.description: If true, this is a one-time chore that expires after being completed or at the end of the day

requires_approval.name: Requires Approval
requires_approval.description: If true, a parent must approve the completion before points are awarded

team_size.name: Team size
team_size.description: Make this a teamwork chore that only counts once this many different children have joined it. When the team is full it submits for all of them. 0 = a normal chore.

team_points_mode.name: Team points
team_points_mode.description: How a teamwork chore pays out: "each" gives every participant the full points, "split" divides them evenly (rounded down).

team_bonus.name: Team bonus
team_bonus.description: Extra points each participant earns when a teamwork chore is completed.

times.name: Set times
times.description: Make this a chore that comes up at set times of day, e.g. wash hands at breakfast, lunch and dinner. A list of up to 5 times, each with name, start and end ("HH:MM", same day, no overlaps) and points.

times_bonus.name: All-times bonus
times_bonus.description: Extra points paid once a day when every set time is done.

assignment_mode.name: Assignment mode
assignment_mode.description: Who does the chore each day: everyone, alternating (take turns), random, balanced (whoever has done it least), first_come (the first child to claim it) or unassigned.

assignment_rotation_period.name: Rotation period
assignment_rotation_period.description: For alternating chores: each_time (the next child each time the chore comes up), week (one child keeps it for whole weeks) or month (whole months).

assignment_rotation_every.name: Rotate every
assignment_rotation_every.description: How many weeks or months each child keeps an alternating chore that has a rotation period (2 = fortnightly).

assignment_rotation_weekday.name: Handover weekday
assignment_rotation_weekday.description: The weekday a weekly rotation passes to the next child.

assignment_rotation_month_day.name: Handover day of month
assignment_rotation_month_day.description: The day of the month a monthly rotation passes to the next child (the last day in shorter months).

schedule_mode.name: Schedule
schedule_mode.description: specific_days (the weekdays in Due days, or every day if none), recurring (on the Recurrence rhythm) or one_shot (today only).

due_days.name: Due days
due_days.description: Weekdays the chore is due on, for the specific_days schedule. Leave empty for every day.

recurrence.name: Recurrence
recurrence.description: How often a recurring chore comes round: weekly, every_2_weeks, monthly, every_3_months, every_6_months, or every_N_days with N from 2 to 365 (e.g. every_10_days).

recurrence_day.name: Recurrence day
recurrence_day.description: The weekday a weekly or every_2_weeks chore falls on.

recurrence_start.name: Recurrence start
recurrence_start.description: The date a recurring chore's rhythm starts from (YYYY-MM-DD).

due_time.name: Due time
due_time.description: Time of day the chore is due ("HH:MM"). Finishing by then earns the early bonus, after it the late penalty. Empty for no due time.

daily_limit.name: Daily limit
daily_limit.description: How many times a day the chore can be completed. One-shot chores are always 1.

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Difficulty tier; scales awarded points by the tier multiplier (medium = ×1.0 baseline)

expires_in_minutes.name: Expires in (minutes)
expires_in_minutes.description: Make this a reactive chore with a deadline this many minutes from now, e.g. the washing machine finished, empty it within 30 minutes. The chore disappears and is disabled once the deadline passes. 0 = no deadline.

speed_bonus_points.name: Speed bonus points
speed_bonus_points.description: Extra points awarded if the chore is completed before the deadline. Needs expires_in_minutes.

update_chore.name: Update Chore
update_chore.description: Change an existing chore by its ID. Only the fields you set are changed; everything else stays as it is.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the chore to change

points.name: Points
points.description: Points awarded when this chore is completed

assigned_to.name: Assigned To
assigned_to.description: Children to assign this chore to, by name or ID. An empty list assigns it to all children

time_category.name: Time Category
time_category.description: When this chore should be completed: morning, afternoon, evening, night, or anytime

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Difficulty tier: easy, medium or hard. Scales the points awarded (medium = ×1.0).

requires_approval.name: Requires Approval
requires_approval.description: If true, a parent must approve the completion before points are awarded

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the chore off (false) to hide it everywhere without deleting it, or back on (true).

speed_bonus_points.name: Speed bonus points
speed_bonus_points.description: Extra points awarded if the chore is completed before its deadline.

team_size.name: Team size
team_size.description: Make this a teamwork chore that only counts once this many different children have joined it. When the team is full it submits for all of them. 0 = a normal chore.

team_points_mode.name: Team points
team_points_mode.description: How a teamwork chore pays out: "each" gives every participant the full points, "split" divides them evenly (rounded down).

team_bonus.name: Team bonus
team_bonus.description: Extra points each participant earns when a teamwork chore is completed.

times.name: Set times
times.description: Replace the chore's set times of day. A list of up to 5 times, each with name, start and end ("HH:MM", same day, no overlaps) and points. An empty list removes them.

times_bonus.name: All-times bonus
times_bonus.description: Extra points paid once a day when every set time is done.

assignment_mode.name: Assignment mode
assignment_mode.description: Who does the chore each day: everyone, alternating (take turns), random, balanced (whoever has done it least), first_come (the first child to claim it) or unassigned.

assignment_rotation_period.name: Rotation period
assignment_rotation_period.description: For alternating chores: each_time (the next child each time the chore comes up), week (one child keeps it for whole weeks) or month (whole months).

assignment_rotation_every.name: Rotate every
assignment_rotation_every.description: How many weeks or months each child keeps an alternating chore that has a rotation period (2 = fortnightly).

assignment_rotation_weekday.name: Handover weekday
assignment_rotation_weekday.description: The weekday a weekly rotation passes to the next child.

assignment_rotation_month_day.name: Handover day of month
assignment_rotation_month_day.description: The day of the month a monthly rotation passes to the next child (the last day in shorter months).

schedule_mode.name: Schedule
schedule_mode.description: specific_days (the weekdays in Due days, or every day if none), recurring (on the Recurrence rhythm) or one_shot (today only).

due_days.name: Due days
due_days.description: Weekdays the chore is due on, for the specific_days schedule. Leave empty for every day.

recurrence.name: Recurrence
recurrence.description: How often a recurring chore comes round: weekly, every_2_weeks, monthly, every_3_months, every_6_months, or every_N_days with N from 2 to 365 (e.g. every_10_days).

recurrence_day.name: Recurrence day
recurrence_day.description: The weekday a weekly or every_2_weeks chore falls on.

recurrence_start.name: Recurrence start
recurrence_start.description: The date a recurring chore's rhythm starts from (YYYY-MM-DD).

due_time.name: Due time
due_time.description: Time of day the chore is due ("HH:MM"). Finishing by then earns the early bonus, after it the late penalty. Empty for no due time.

daily_limit.name: Daily limit
daily_limit.description: How many times a day the chore can be completed. One-shot chores are always 1.

delete_chore.name: Delete Chore
delete_chore.description: Delete a chore by its ID, with the same clean-up as the panel. It goes to Recently deleted in the panel for 7 days, so it can be restored.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the chore to delete

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. A safeguard so a chore is never deleted by accident.

skip_chore.name: Skip Chore
skip_chore.description: Advance today's rotation past the current assignee. Ephemeral — tomorrow's rotation resumes as normal.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the chore to skip

set_chore_manual_start.name: Set Manual Start Child
set_chore_manual_start.description: Set which child starts a rotating chore. For alternating mode this reorders the pool; for random/balanced it only overrides today's assignee.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the chore to update

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child who should start the rotation

add_task_group.name: Add Task Group
add_task_group.description: Create a task group (sticky = same child, spread = different children).

chore_ids.name: Chore IDs
chore_ids.description: List of chore IDs in the group. For sticky, the first chore is the leader.

update_task_group.name: Update Task Group
update_task_group.description: Update a task group's name, policy, or membership.

group_id.name: Group ID
group_id.description: The ID of the group to update

chore_ids.name: Chore IDs
chore_ids.description: Replacement chore ID list. For sticky, the first chore is the leader.

remove_task_group.name: Remove Task Group
remove_task_group.description: Delete a task group. Member chores are not affected.

group_id.name: Group ID
group_id.description: The ID of the group to delete

start_timed_task.name: Start Timed Task
start_timed_task.description: Start or resume the timer on a timed task

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the timed chore

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child starting the timer

leave_team_chore.name: Leave Teamwork Chore
leave_team_chore.description: Take a child back out of a teamwork chore they joined today, before the team is complete

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the teamwork chore

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child leaving the team

complete_next_chore.name: Complete Next Chore
complete_next_chore.description: Complete the child's next outstanding chore, in the order the child card shows them. Chores that need a photo, a note, a timer or a team are skipped. Made for watch buttons and shortcuts; normal approval rules apply.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose next chore to complete

post_bounty.name: Post Bounty
post_bounty.description: Post a one-off job to the bounty board for a fixed number of points. Any eligible child can claim it; finishing it goes through the normal approval queue.

title.name: Title
title.description: What the job is, e.g. "Wash the car"

points.name: Points
points.description: Fixed points paid when a parent approves the finished job

description.name: Description
description.description: Optional extra detail for the children

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: MDI icon shown on the board

expires_at.name: Expires at
expires_at.description: Optional date and time the bounty leaves the board if nobody has claimed it. Leave empty for no expiry.

eligible_child_ids.name: Eligible children
eligible_child_ids.description: IDs of the children who may claim it. Empty = every child.

claim_hours.name: Claim lock (hours)
claim_hours.description: How long a claim lasts before the bounty goes back on the board

require_photo.name: Require photo
require_photo.description: The child must attach a photo when marking it done

notify_children.name: Notify children
notify_children.description: Send the "New bounty" notification to the eligible children

update_bounty.name: Update Bounty
update_bounty.description: Edit a bounty. Once it has been claimed, only its points and expiry can change.

bounty_id.description: The ID of the bounty to edit

claim_bounty.description: Claim a bounty for a child, locking it to them for its claim period. A child can hold one claim at a time.

bounty_id.name: Bounty ID
bounty_id.description: The ID of the bounty to claim

give_back_bounty.description: Hand a claimed bounty back to the board so another child can take it

bounty_id.description: The ID of the claimed bounty

complete_bounty.description: Mark a claimed bounty as done. It goes to the approval queue like a chore.

child_id.description: The ID of the child who claimed it

photo_url.name: Photo URL
photo_url.description: Photo of the finished job (required when the bounty asks for one)

pause_timed_task.name: Pause Timed Task
pause_timed_task.description: Pause a running timed task timer

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the timed chore

child_id.description: The ID of the child pausing the timer

stop_timed_task.description: Stop a timed task timer and submit for approval

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the timed chore

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child stopping the timer

description.name: Description

tier.name: Tier

point_bonus.name: Point bonus
point_bonus.description: Points credited to the child when the badge is earned

criteria.name: Criteria

badge_id.description: The ID of the badge to update

tier.name: Tier

point_bonus.name: Point bonus

awarded_badge_id.description: The ID of the awarded badge record to revoke

rebuild_badges.name: Rebuild Badges
rebuild_badges.description: Re-evaluate all badges across all children silently (no notifications, no point bonuses).

apply_mandatory_penalty.name: Apply Mandatory Penalty
apply_mandatory_penalty.description: Deduct the configured penalty points for a missed mandatory chore and clear the review item.

miss_id.name: Miss ID
miss_id.description: The ID of the mandatory-miss review item

choose_avatar.name: Choose Avatar
choose_avatar.description: A child switches to an avatar they have unlocked.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child

icon.name: Avatar icon
icon.description: The mdi icon of an unlocked catalogue avatar (e.g. mdi:rocket-launch).

dismiss_mandatory_chore.name: Dismiss Mandatory Chore
dismiss_mandatory_chore.description: Clear a missed mandatory chore review item with no penalty.

miss_id.name: Miss ID
miss_id.description: The ID of the mandatory-miss review item

gift_points.name: Gift Points
gift_points.description: Transfer spendable points from one child to another (parent-controlled).

from_child_id.name: From child ID
from_child_id.description: The ID of the child sending points

to_child_id.name: To child ID
to_child_id.description: The ID of the child receiving points

points.name: Points
points.description: The number of points to transfer

adjust_streak_freezes.name: Adjust Streak Freezes
adjust_streak_freezes.description: Give a child streak-freeze tokens (positive amount) or take some away (negative). A grant never goes past the streak_freeze_max cap.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose tokens change

postpone_mandatory_chore.name: Postpone Mandatory Chore
postpone_mandatory_chore.description: Give a missed mandatory chore another period (or tomorrow) without a penalty, and clear the review item.

miss_id.name: Miss ID
miss_id.description: The ID of the mandatory-miss review item

chore_id.description: The ID of the chore to take over

requester_id.name: Requester child ID
requester_id.description: The ID of the child requesting the swap

test_notification.name: Test Notification
test_notification.description: Send a sample notification of the given type to its enabled recipients (ignores the master on/off so routing can be verified).

type_id.name: Notification type
type_id.description: Notification type id, e.g. pending_chore_approval, badge_earned, streak_milestone

record_allowance_payout.name: Record Allowance Payout
record_allowance_payout.description: Deduct points and record a real-money allowance payout in the ledger (fixed conversion rate; parent-controlled).

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child receiving the payout

points.name: Points
points.description: Points to convert to cash and deduct

add_wish.name: Add Wish
add_wish.description: A child adds something they want to save for. It waits for a parent to approve it.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child making the wish

target.name: Target
target.description: Suggested number of points it costs. The parent can change it when approving.

link.name: Link
link.description: Optional web address (http or https) for the thing

photo_url.name: Picture
photo_url.description: Optional picture just uploaded through the TaskMate photo endpoint

withdraw_wish.name: Withdraw Wish
withdraw_wish.description: A child takes back a wish that is still waiting for approval, or clears one that was declined.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose wish it is

move_points_to_wish.name: Move Points to Wish
move_points_to_wish.description: Move points from a child's spendable balance into one of their approved wishes.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose wish it is

points.name: Points
points.description: How many points to move (capped at the balance and at what the wish still needs)

take_points_from_wish.name: Take Points from Wish
take_points_from_wish.description: Give some of a child's own saved points back from a wish. Pledged points never come out.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose wish it is

points.name: Points
points.description: How many saved points to take back (capped at what the child saved)

request_wish_redeem.name: Ask to Redeem Wish
request_wish_redeem.description: A fully funded wish becomes a reward claim waiting for the parent's approval.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose wish it is

approve_wish.name: Approve Wish
approve_wish.description: Turn a waiting wish into a savings goal, optionally at a different target.

target.name: Target
target.description: Points the wish costs. Leave empty to keep the child's suggestion.

decline_wish.name: Decline Wish
decline_wish.description: Say no to a wish. Saved points go back to the child and pledges are voided.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason shown to the child

pledge_to_wish.name: Pledge to Wish
pledge_to_wish.description: Record points a relative chips in towards a child's wish. They never touch any balance.

name.name: From
name.description: Who the pledge is from, e.g. Grandma

points.name: Points
points.description: How many points to pledge (capped at what the wish still needs)

remove_wish_pledge.name: Remove Wish Pledge
remove_wish_pledge.description: Undo a pledge. Allowed until the wish is redeemed.

pledge_id.name: Pledge ID
pledge_id.description: The ID of the pledge to remove

remove_wish.name: Remove Wish
remove_wish.description: Delete a wish. Saved points go back to the child and pledges are voided.

start_inspection.name: Start Inspection
start_inspection.description: Flag a chore approved in the last 24 hours for a surprise inspection. Pass or fail it before the window closes; an undecided inspection closes quietly.

completion_id.name: Completion ID
completion_id.description: The ID of the approved chore completion to inspect

bonus.name: Bonus
bonus.description: Points paid if it passes. Defaults to the Settings value.

window.name: Window
window.description: How long you have to check it: 1h, 2h, 4h or bed (until bedtime). Defaults to the Settings value.

tell_child.name: Tell the child
tell_child.description: Show "Inspection coming" on the child's card now. Turn off for a secret check.

pass_inspection.name: Pass Inspection
pass_inspection.description: The inspected chore passed. Pays the bonus as a normal points entry and celebrates on the child's card.

inspection_id.name: Inspection ID
inspection_id.description: The ID of the open inspection

bonus.name: Bonus
bonus.description: Points to pay. Defaults to the bonus set when the inspection started.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note shown to the child

fail_inspection.name: Fail Inspection
fail_inspection.description: The inspected chore didn't pass. No points are taken. It can be sent back to redo; the redo earns nothing extra.

inspection_id.name: Inspection ID
inspection_id.description: The ID of the open inspection

redo.name: Send back to redo
redo.description: Put the chore back on the child's list as not done for today. Defaults to the Settings value.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note shown to the child (what needs fixing)

cancel_inspection.name: Cancel Inspection
cancel_inspection.description: Call off an open inspection, as if it never started.

inspection_id.name: Inspection ID
inspection_id.description: The ID of the open inspection

request_help.name: Ask for help
request_help.description: A child says they are stuck on a chore. Sends the parents a push; nothing is completed or skipped.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child asking for help

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The chore they are stuck on

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional words from the child, e.g. "I can't reach the shelf".

answer_help.name: Answer a help request
answer_help.description: Mark a child's help request as answered, so their card stops saying help is on its way.

log_mood.name: Log mood
log_mood.description: A child says how their day went. One per day; logging again replaces it.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child

mood.name: Mood
mood.description: great, good, ok, sad or upset

set_sick_day.name: Set sick day
set_sick_day.description: Give a child a sick day. Their chores are hidden, their streak is frozen and no mandatory chore is missed.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child who is unwell

date.name: Date
date.description: The day (default today). From a week ago to a month ahead.

sick.name: Sick
sick.description: Turn off to take the sick day back.

set_weekly_goal.name: Set weekly goal
set_weekly_goal.description: Set a child's own weekly points goal. Reaching it pays the family's weekly goal bonus once a week. 0 clears it.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child

buy_raffle_tickets.name: Buy raffle tickets
buy_raffle_tickets.description: A child spends points on tickets for a raffle. Each ticket is one chance in the draw.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child buying

draw_raffle.name: Draw raffle
draw_raffle.description: Draw a raffle's winner now instead of waiting for its draw time.

adopt_pet.name: Adopt a pet
adopt_pet.description: A child adopts (or renames) their virtual pet. It grows with every chore they finish from now on.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child

species.name: Species
species.description: dragon, cat, dog, bunny, dino or unicorn

hatch_egg.name: Hatch the egg
hatch_egg.description: Hatch the egg the grown-up pet laid into a new pet. The old pet joins the pet family.

buy_pet_item.name: Buy a pet item
buy_pet_item.description: A child buys an item from the pet shop with their spendable points. Over the parents' approval threshold it waits for a parent instead.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child buying

equip_pet_item.name: Dress the pet
equip_pet_item.description: Put an owned or level-unlocked item on the child's pet (replacing whatever is in that slot), or take it off.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: A pet shop item, or bow, top_hat, scarf or crown

wear.name: Wear it
wear.description: On puts it on; off takes it off.

mark_reward_delivered.name: Mark reward delivered
mark_reward_delivered.description: A redeemed reward has been handed over, so it leaves the owed list. Give child_id when the child is confirming their own.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child confirming they received it (leave empty when a parent marks it)

start_boost.name: Start a boost
start_boost.description: Open a boost window. Chores done inside it pay the multiplier. Leave chore_ids or child_ids empty for all of them.

multiplier.name: Multiplier
multiplier.description: What the covered chores pay, e.g. 2 for double (1.1 to 5)

chore_ids.name: Chore IDs
chore_ids.description: The chores it covers (empty = all chores)

starts_at.name: Starts at
starts_at.description: Start later instead of now (up to a week ahead)

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional label shown on the cards, e.g. "Guests at six"

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Send the boost push to the children it covers (when that notification is switched on)

end_boost.name: End a boost
end_boost.description: Stop a boost early, or call off one that hasn't started yet.

boost_id.name: Boost ID
boost_id.description: The boost, from the boosts attribute of sensor.taskmate_overview

appeal.name: Appeal
appeal.description: A child asks for a second look at a rejected chore, a rejected reward claim or a penalty from the last 48 hours. Needs appeals switched on.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child appealing

target_id.name: Target ID
target_id.description: The item, from the appealable attribute of the child's entry in sensor.taskmate_overview

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional words from the child, up to 200 characters

decide_appeal.name: Decide an appeal
decide_appeal.description: Overturn an appeal (pay the chore, approve the reward or undo the penalty) or uphold the original decision.

overturn.name: Overturn
overturn.description: true to overturn, false to uphold

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional words for the child, up to 200 characters

adjust_screen_time.name: Adjust screen time
adjust_screen_time.description: Add minutes to a child's screen-time balance, or take some away with a negative number.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child whose balance changes

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes to add; negative to take away. The balance never goes below zero.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: A short note for the balance history

save_screen_time.name: Save screen time
save_screen_time.description: Move a child's unused screen-time minutes into their weekend jar. Today's allowance goes in first, then banked minutes, up to the jar's cap.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child saving the minutes

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How many minutes to save. Leave empty to save everything that fits.

rate_reward.name: Rate a reward
rate_reward.description: The child gives a reward they have had 1 to 3 stars. Once the reward is handed over (or approved, when fulfilment tracking is off), for 3 days.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child who had the reward

sibling_check.name: Sibling check
sibling_check.description: A child checks a sibling's chore that is waiting for approval. done approves it and pays the checker the sibling-check bonus; not_yet leaves it waiting for a parent, with a note.

child_id.name: Checker child ID
child_id.description: The child doing the checking (not the one who did the chore)

completion_id.name: Completion ID
completion_id.description: The waiting completion, from the sibling_checks attribute of the checker's entry in sensor.taskmate_overview

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional words for the parent with a not_yet, up to 120 characters

set_chore_reminder.name: Set chore reminder
set_chore_reminder.description: A child picks when to be reminded about one of their chores, inside the earliest and latest times set in TaskMate's settings. Leave the time empty to clear it.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The child who wants reminding

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The chore to be reminded about

time.name: Time
time.description: HH:MM, e.g. 17:30. Empty clears the reminder.

read_aloud.name: Read Chores Aloud
read_aloud.description: Speak a child's outstanding chores on a media player, for example "Ella, you have three things left…". Uses the read-aloud wording in Home Assistant's language unless custom read-aloud templates are set.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose chores are read out

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Where to speak. Falls back to the default set in Settings.

tts_entity.name: Text-to-speech entity
tts_entity.description: Which TTS service to use. Falls back to Settings, then to the only one installed.

message.name: Message override
message.description: Say this instead of the generated summary.

spin_roulette.name: Spin Chore Roulette
spin_roulette.description: Pick a random outstanding chore for a child at a points multiplier. Opt-in: turn it on and set the multiplier and daily spin allowance in the TaskMate panel settings.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child spinning

state.reset: Reset — streak goes to 0 on missed day
state.pause: Pause — streak preserved until next completion

notify_service_missing.title: TaskMate can't send notifications to {who}
notify_service_missing.description:
TaskMate is set to notify {who} through `{service}`, but that service doesn't exist any more — usually because the phone was removed or renamed in the Mobile App integration.

Open the TaskMate admin panel → Notifications and pick the current service for {who}. This repair clears itself once the service exists.

child_entity_missing.title: {child}'s profile uses a missing entity
child_entity_missing.description:
{child}'s profile uses `{entity}`, which no longer exists. Availability, presence-aware reminders or the profile picture that rely on it won't work.

Open the TaskMate admin panel → Children, edit {child} and pick an entity that exists (or clear the field).

chore_entity_missing.title: “{chore}” uses a missing entity
chore_entity_missing.description:
“{chore}” checks `{entity}` to decide when it shows, but that entity no longer exists, so the check is skipped.

Open the TaskMate admin panel → Chores, edit “{chore}” and pick an entity that exists (or clear it).

chore_assigned_to_nobody.title: The chore “{chore}” is assigned to nobody
chore_assigned_to_nobody.description:
Every child “{chore}” was assigned to has been removed, so no one will ever see it.

Open the TaskMate admin panel → Chores and assign “{chore}” to a child, or delete it.

chore_dependency_missing.title: The chore “{chore}” can never unlock
chore_dependency_missing.description:
“{chore}” waits for another chore to be done first, but that chore has been deleted, so “{chore}” stays locked for ever.

Open the TaskMate admin panel → Chores, edit “{chore}” and remove the missing dependency.

reward_assigned_to_nobody.title: No child can claim the reward “{reward}”
reward_assigned_to_nobody.description:
Every child “{reward}” was meant for has been removed, so no one can claim it.

Open the TaskMate admin panel → Rewards and choose who “{reward}” is for, or delete it.

reward_unlock_not_allowed.title: The reward “{reward}” unlocks nothing
reward_unlock_not_allowed.description:
“{reward}” is set to switch on `{entity}`, but that entity is no longer on TaskMate's unlock allowlist, so nothing happens when the reward is approved.

Open the TaskMate admin panel → Settings and add `{entity}` to the unlock allowlist, or edit “{reward}”.
